# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI/CD
- [ ] Other

## Related Issue

Closes #

## Requirements and Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Requirements are documented or linked.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Non-goals are respected.

## Architecture

- [ ] Architecture impact reviewed.
- [ ] ADR created or updated, if relevant.
- [ ] API contract updated, if relevant.
- [ ] Data model impact reviewed.

## Security Review

- [ ] Authentication impact reviewed.
- [ ] Authorization impact reviewed.
- [ ] Input validation reviewed.
- [ ] Secrets are not hardcoded.
- [ ] Logs do not expose sensitive data.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified.
- [ ] Firebase rules reviewed, if applicable.
- [ ] Cloudflare exposure reviewed, if applicable.
- [ ] MCP/tooling impact reviewed, if applicable.

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated.
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated, if needed.
- [ ] Manual testing completed, if needed.
- [ ] Regression risk considered.

## Deployment and Rollback

- [ ] Deployment impact documented.
- [ ] Environment variables documented.
- [ ] Rollback path documented.
- [ ] Staging validation completed, if applicable.

## AI Assistance Disclosure

- [ ] AI was used to assist this change.
- [ ] AI-generated changes were reviewed by a human.
- [ ] No sensitive production data was shared with AI tools.

## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes.
- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] Code review completed.
- [ ] Remaining risks documented.
